target_outcome_row: Logic remains inside llm_mvp_core and extensions stay thin
focus: architecture boundary and deterministic shortcut prevention
finding_summary: Plan already required thin adapters and core model boundaries, but needed an explicit rule that scorer/router/counter/dictionary/KNN helpers are support evidence only and cannot become architecture patterns or final semantic authority.

findings.description: The plan did not explicitly quarantine scorer/router/counter/dictionary/KNN helpers as support implementation only.

recheck_evidence: Required rg terms were checked in the active plan.
Section 5.2 now forces host adapters to build XiigenExtensionRequest, call llm_mvp_core, and render XiigenExtensionResponse/debug/error only.
Section 5.2 requires model/training/DPO/eval/token/source/license/checkpoint/rollback/promotion logic to live in llm_mvp_core or approved user-local assets through the core boundary.
Section 5.2 limits trainable algorithms to ILogicalUnit, ILogicalFlow, ILogicalOrchestrator, ILearningMachine, or approved pair/composition forms.
Section 5.2 labels deterministic baselines/counters/dictionaries/KNN/scorers/routers as baseline/support/diagnostic/ablation evidence only.
Section 6.1 architecture review now blocks scorer/router/counter/dictionary/KNN helpers from becoming new architecture patterns or final semantic authority.
Inconclusive boundary evidence keeps status IN_PROGRESS_NEXT_STEP_KNOWN.
